verdict.rationale: An API spec is a fair question for a legal-services SaaS platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable API specification. The llms.txt file found by the probe is crawler guidance for AI systems, not an API spec, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
